```{r setup, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(scales)
library(DT)
library(plotly)
library(bslib)
library(htmltools)

if (requireNamespace("TARegEco", quietly = TRUE)) {
  library(TARegEco)
} else {
  devtools::load_all(".")
}

# Ekstrak parameter
result_scenario  <- params$result_scenario
result_bau       <- params$result_bau
recap_scenario   <- params$recap_scenario
recap_bau        <- params$recap_bau
indicator_labels <- params$indicator_labels
sector_names     <- params$sector_names
years            <- params$years
active_assumptions <- params$assumption_active

# Agregasi by year: sum semua sektor
agg_by_year <- function(df, col) {
  df |> dplyr::group_by(YEAR) |>
    dplyr::summarise(Total = sum(.data[[col]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}

# Siapkan seri per indikator
build_series <- function(col) {
  b <- agg_by_year(result_bau, col) |> dplyr::mutate(Seri = "BAU")
  s <- agg_by_year(result_scenario, col) |> dplyr::mutate(Seri = "Skenario")
  dplyr::bind_rows(b, s)
}

# Helper: bikin tabel rekapitulasi per indikator (BAU vs Skenario + selisih)
build_recap_table <- function(col, label) {
  b <- agg_by_year(result_bau, col)      |> dplyr::rename(BAU = Total)
  s <- agg_by_year(result_scenario, col) |> dplyr::rename(Skenario = Total)
  
  dplyr::left_join(b, s, by = "YEAR") |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Selisih_Pct = (Skenario / BAU - 1) * 100
    ) |>
    dplyr::rename(
      Tahun          = YEAR,
      `Selisih (%)`  = Selisih_Pct
    )
}

# Helper: bikin ggplot interaktif per indikator
# Helper: bikin ggplot interaktif per indikator
build_plot <- function(col, label) {
  d <- build_series(col)
  d$Seri <- factor(d$Seri, levels = c("BAU", "Skenario"))
  
  # Ambil satuan dari ind_units (jika ada), fallback ke string kosong
  unit <- if (exists("ind_units") && col %in% names(ind_units)) {
    ind_units[[col]]
  } else {
    ""
  }
  
  # Y axis title dengan satuan
  y_title <- if (nzchar(unit)) {
    paste0(label, " (", unit, ")")
  } else {
    label
  }
  
  p <- ggplot(
    d,
    aes(
      x = YEAR,
      y = Total,
      color = Seri,
      group = Seri,
      text  = paste0(
        "Tahun: ", YEAR,
        "<br>Seri: ", Seri,
        "<br>Nilai: ", scales::comma(Total, accuracy = 1),
        if (nzchar(unit)) paste0(" ", unit) else ""
      )
    )
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = unique(d$YEAR),
      labels = function(x) format(x, big.mark = "", scientific = FALSE)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("BAU" = "#7f8c8d", "Skenario" = "#27ae60")) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle  = 45,
        hjust  = 1,
        vjust  = 1
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Proyeksi", label),
      x     = "Tahun",
      y     = y_title,
      color = NULL
    )
  
  plotly::ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
}

# Mapping: kolom → label (digunakan untuk iterasi)
ind_cols   <- c("GDP", "LABOUR", "INCOME", "SURPLUS", "OUTPUT")
ind_titles <- c(
  "GDP"     = "Proyeksi PDRB",
  "LABOUR"  = "Proyeksi Serapan Tenaga Kerja",
  "INCOME"  = "Proyeksi Pendapatan Tenaga Kerja",
  "SURPLUS" = "Proyeksi Surplus Usaha Bruto",
  "OUTPUT"  = "Proyeksi Output Total"
)
ind_units  <- c(
  "GDP"     = "Rp Juta",
  "LABOUR"  = "Orang",
  "INCOME"  = "Rp Juta",
  "SURPLUS" = "Rp Juta",
  "OUTPUT"  = "Rp Juta"
)

has_a3 <- "A3" %in% active_assumptions
```

```{r analysis-log, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Helper untuk mengamankan nilai NULL / character(0) agar tidak merusak tribble
safe_str <- function(val, default = "-") {
  if (is.null(val) || length(val) == 0 || is.na(val) || val == "" || val == "NA") {
    return(default)
  }
  return(as.character(val))
}

# --- Siapkan daftar file input ---
input_files <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Kategori,                     ~Keterangan,
  "Baseline (Deskriptif)",       safe_str(params$file_baseline),
  "Proyeksi Lahan BAU",          safe_str(params$file_bau),
  "Asumsi 1: Perubahan Lahan",   safe_str(params$file_a1, "- (tidak dipakai)"),
  "Asumsi 2: Produktivitas LPC", safe_str(params$file_a2, "- (tidak dipakai)"),
  "Asumsi 3: Hilirisasi",        safe_str(params$file_a3, "- (tidak dipakai)")
)

# --- Log utama ---
analysis_log <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Kategori,               ~Keterangan,
  "Waktu Mulai Analisis",  safe_str(params$start_time),
  "Waktu Selesai Analisis", safe_str(params$end_time),
  "Skenario",              safe_str(params$scenario_name),
  "Asumsi Aktif",          if (length(active_assumptions) > 0) paste(active_assumptions, collapse = " + ") else "-",
  "Tahun Awal",            safe_str(params$initial_year),
  "Tahun Akhir",           safe_str(params$end_year),
  "Interval",              paste0(safe_str(params$time_step), " tahun"),
  "Lokasi",                safe_str(params$location),
  "Satuan",                safe_str(params$unit),
  "Direktori Output",      safe_str(params$output_dir)
)

# --- Gabungkan ---
analysis_log_full <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  analysis_log,
  tibble::tibble(Kategori = "--- Data Input ---", Keterangan = ""),
  input_files
)

analysis_log_full %>%
  kableExtra::kbl(caption = "Log Analisis", escape = FALSE) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_paper("hover", full_width = FALSE) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(font_size = 13)
```

# Pendahuluan

Laporan ini menyajikan hasil proyeksi ekonomi regional untuk `r params$location` dengan skenario `r params$scenario_name`. Analisis menggunakan model Supply-Constrained Mixed Input-Output (Hubacek & Sun, 2001) untuk memproyeksikan indikator makroekonomi regional pada periode `r params$initial_year`–`r params$end_year`.

Asumsi yang diaktifkan: `r paste(active_assumptions, collapse = ", ")`

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
descriptions <- c(
  "BAU" = "**BAU (Business As Usual)** — Baseline tanpa intervensi; hanya tutupan lahan BAU yang digunakan.",
  "A1"  = "**Asumsi 1 (Perubahan Lahan)** — Perubahan luas/distribusi tutupan lahan memengaruhi output sektor berbasis lahan.",
  "A2"  = "**Asumsi 2 (Peningkatan Produktivitas)** — Peningkatan LPC (Land Productivity Coefficient) secara bertahap menuju target.",
  "A3"  = "**Asumsi 3 (Hilirisasi)** — Restrukturisasi tabel Input-Output via RAS balancing yang mengubah struktur keterkaitan antar sektor."
)

for (a in active_assumptions) {
  if (a %in% names(descriptions)) {
    cat("- ", descriptions[[a]], "\n", sep = "")
  }
}
```

## Proyeksi Lahan BAU

```{r input-BAU, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
file_path_bau <- params$file_bau

if (!is.null(file_path_bau) && file.exists(as.character(file_path_bau))) {
  sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(file_path_bau)
  target_sheet <- if ("luc_projection" %in% sheets) "luc_projection" else sheets[1]
  
  df_bau <- readxl::read_excel(file_path_bau, sheet = target_sheet)
  
  # 1. Konversi otomatis kolom teks yang berisi angka menjadi numerik
  df_bau <- df_bau |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(everything(), ~ {
      num_conv <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.)))
      if (!all(is.na(num_conv) == is.na(.))) num_conv else .
    }))
  
  # 2. Identifikasi kolom numerik (kecualikan ID)
  all_num_cols <- names(df_bau)[sapply(df_bau, is.numeric)]
  num_cols_to_format <- setdiff(all_num_cols, c("ID", "id", "Id"))
  
  # 3. Bulatkan nilai numerik ke 2 desimal di level dataframe
  if (length(num_cols_to_format) > 0) {
    df_bau <- df_bau |>
      dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(num_cols_to_format), ~ round(., 2)))
  }
  
  # 4. Buat objek datatable
  dt <- DT::datatable(
    df_bau,
    rownames = FALSE,
    caption = paste0("Tabel Proyeksi Luas Lahan BAU (Sheet: ", target_sheet, ")"),
    extensions = "Buttons",
    options = list(
      pageLength = 10,
      dom = "Bfrtip",
      buttons = c("copy", "excel", "csv"),
      scrollX = TRUE
    )
  )
  
  # 5. Format tampilan 2 desimal & pemisah ribuan
  if (length(num_cols_to_format) > 0) {
    dt <- dt |>
      DT::formatRound(columns = num_cols_to_format, digits = 2, mark = ",")
  }
  
  dt
} else {
  render_notice("File data input Proyeksi Lahan BAU tidak ditemukan atau path file tidak valid.")
}
```

## Asumsi 1: Perubahan Lahan

```{r input-A1, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
has_a1 <- "A1" %in% active_assumptions
file_path_a1 <- params$file_a1

if (has_a1 && !is.null(file_path_a1) && file.exists(as.character(file_path_a1))) {
  sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(file_path_a1)
  
  # Helper function untuk membuat Data Table + format 2 desimal dinamis
  create_dt <- function(df, caption_text) {
    # 1. Konversi otomatis kolom teks yang berisi angka menjadi numerik
    df <- df |>
      dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(everything(), ~ {
        num_conv <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.)))
        if (!all(is.na(num_conv) == is.na(.))) num_conv else .
      }))
    
    # 2. Identifikasi kolom numerik (kecualikan ID)
    all_num_cols <- names(df)[sapply(df, is.numeric)]
    num_cols <- setdiff(all_num_cols, c("ID", "id", "Id"))
    
    # 3. Bulatkan ke 2 desimal di level dataframe
    if (length(num_cols) > 0) {
      df <- df |>
        dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(num_cols), ~ round(., 2)))
    }
    
    # 4. Buat objek datatable
    dt <- DT::datatable(
      df,
      rownames = FALSE,
      caption = caption_text,
      extensions = "Buttons",
      options = list(
        pageLength = 10,
        dom = "Bfrtip",
        buttons = c("copy", "excel", "csv"),
        scrollX = TRUE
      )
    )
    
    # 5. Format tampilan 2 desimal & pemisah ribuan
    if (length(num_cols) > 0) {
      dt <- dt |>
        DT::formatRound(columns = num_cols, digits = 2, mark = ",")
    }
    
    return(dt)
  }
  
  # 1. Cek ketersediaan sheet
  has_luc <- "luc_projection" %in% sheets
  has_land <- "land_proportion" %in% sheets
  
  # 2. Baca sheet utama (luc_projection atau sheet pertama)
  target_sheet <- if (has_luc) "luc_projection" else sheets[1]
  df_a1 <- readxl::read_excel(file_path_a1, sheet = target_sheet)
  dt_a1 <- create_dt(df_a1, paste0("Tabel Asumsi 1: Perubahan Luas Lahan (Sheet: ", target_sheet, ")"))
  
  # 3. Kondisi jika ada sheet land_proportion -> Tampilkan dalam Tabset
  if (has_land) {
    df_land <- readxl::read_excel(file_path_a1, sheet = "land_proportion")
    dt_land <- create_dt(df_land, "Tabel Asumsi 1: Proporsi Lahan (Sheet: land_proportion)")
    
    bslib::navset_card_tab(
      bslib::nav_panel(title = paste0("Luas Lahan (", target_sheet, ")"), dt_a1),
      bslib::nav_panel(title = "Proporsi Lahan (land_proportion)", dt_land)
    )
  } else {
    # Jika hanya ada 1 sheet, tampilkan datatable biasa
    dt_a1
  }
} else if (has_a1) {
  render_notice("Asumsi 1 diaktifkan, namun file input Asumsi 1 tidak ditemukan atau path tidak valid.")
} else {
  render_notice("Asumsi 1 (Perubahan Lahan) tidak diaktifkan pada skenario ini.")
}
```

## Asumsi 2: Produktivitas LPC

```{r input-A2, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
has_a2 <- "A2" %in% active_assumptions
file_path_a2 <- params$file_a2

if (has_a2 && !is.null(file_path_a2) && file.exists(as.character(file_path_a2))) {
  sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(file_path_a2)
  
  # Deteksi nama sheet dan penentuan skip_rows untuk melompati baris judul template
  if ("Skenario_LPC" %in% sheets) {
    target_sheet <- "Skenario_LPC"
    skip_rows <- 11
  } else if ("produktivitas_lpc" %in% sheets) {
    target_sheet <- "produktivitas_lpc"
    skip_rows <- 0
  } else if ("lpc" %in% sheets) {
    target_sheet <- "lpc"
    skip_rows <- 0
  } else {
    target_sheet <- sheets[1]
    skip_rows <- 0
  }
  
  df_a2 <- readxl::read_excel(file_path_a2, sheet = target_sheet, skip = skip_rows)
  
  # 1. Konversi otomatis kolom angka yang terbaca sebagai teks
  df_a2 <- df_a2 |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(everything(), ~ {
      num_conv <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.)))
      if (!all(is.na(num_conv) == is.na(.))) num_conv else .
    }))
  
  # 2. Identifikasi kolom numerik (kecualikan ID/Kode)
  all_num_cols <- names(df_a2)[sapply(df_a2, is.numeric)]
  num_cols_to_format <- setdiff(all_num_cols, c("ID", "id", "Id", "KODE", "Kode", "NO", "No"))
  
  # 3. Bulatkan nilai ke 2 desimal di level dataframe
  if (length(num_cols_to_format) > 0) {
    df_a2 <- df_a2 |>
      dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(num_cols_to_format), ~ round(., 2)))
  }
  
  # 4. Buat objek datatable
  dt <- DT::datatable(
    df_a2,
    rownames = FALSE,
    caption = paste0("Tabel Asumsi 2: Target Produktivitas LPC (Sheet: ", target_sheet, ")"),
    extensions = "Buttons",
    options = list(
      pageLength = 10,
      dom = "Bfrtip",
      buttons = c("copy", "excel", "csv"),
      scrollX = TRUE
    )
  )
  
  # 5. Format tampilan 2 desimal & pemisah ribuan
  if (length(num_cols_to_format) > 0) {
    dt <- dt |>
      DT::formatRound(columns = num_cols_to_format, digits = 2, mark = ",")
  }
  
  dt
} else if (has_a2) {
  render_notice("Asumsi 2 diaktifkan, namun file input Asumsi 2 tidak ditemukan atau path tidak valid.")
} else {
  render_notice("Asumsi 2 (Peningkatan Produktivitas LPC) tidak diaktifkan pada skenario ini.")
}
```

## Asumsi 3: Hilirisasi

```{r input-A3, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
has_a3 <- "A3" %in% active_assumptions
file_path_a3 <- params$file_a3

if (has_a3 && !is.null(file_path_a3) && file.exists(as.character(file_path_a3))) {
  sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(file_path_a3)
  
  # Deteksi nama sheet dan penentuan skip_rows
  if ("Restrukturisasi" %in% sheets) {
    target_sheet <- "Restrukturisasi"
    skip_rows <- 11
  } else if ("Skenario_4_Restrukturisasi" %in% sheets) {
    target_sheet <- "Skenario_4_Restrukturisasi"
    skip_rows <- 11
  } else {
    target_sheet <- sheets[1]
    skip_rows <- 0
  }
  
  df_a3 <- readxl::read_excel(file_path_a3, sheet = target_sheet, skip = skip_rows)
  
  # Filter & kerapihan teks secara aman (jika kolom sektor asal ditemukan)
  col_from <- names(df_a3)[grep("SEKTOR ASAL|FROM SECTOR", names(df_a3), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
  col_to   <- names(df_a3)[grep("SEKTOR TUJUAN|TO SECTOR", names(df_a3), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
  
  if (!is.na(col_from)) {
    df_a3 <- df_a3 |>
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[col_from]])) |>
      dplyr::mutate(.data[[col_from]] := trimws(.data[[col_from]]))
  }
  if (!is.na(col_to)) {
    df_a3 <- df_a3 |>
      dplyr::mutate(.data[[col_to]] := trimws(.data[[col_to]]))
  }
  
  DT::datatable(
    df_a3,
    rownames = FALSE,
    caption = paste0("Tabel Asumsi 3: Restrukturisasi Tabel I-O (Sheet: ", target_sheet, ")"),
    extensions = "Buttons",
    options = list(
      pageLength = 10,
      dom = "Bfrtip",
      buttons = c("copy", "excel", "csv"),
      scrollX = TRUE
    )
  )
} else if (has_a3) {
  render_notice("Asumsi 3 diaktifkan, namun file input Asumsi 3 tidak ditemukan atau path tidak valid.")
} else {
  render_notice("Asumsi 3 (Hilirisasi / Restrukturisasi I-O) tidak diaktifkan pada skenario ini.")
}
```

# Ringkasan

```{r summary-table, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# ---- 1. Fungsi bantu: ringkasan per indikator ----
summary_row <- function(df, col, label, unit) {
  d <- agg_by_year(df, col)
  tibble::tibble(
    Indikator         = label,
    Satuan            = unit,
    `Nilai Awal`      = d$Total[1],
    `Nilai Akhir`     = d$Total[nrow(d)],
    `Pertumbuhan (%)` = (d$Total[nrow(d)] / d$Total[1] - 1) * 100
  )
}

# ---- 2. Ringkasan BAU ----
sum_bau <- purrr::map2_dfr(
  ind_cols, seq_along(ind_cols),
  ~ summary_row(result_bau, .x, ind_titles[.x], ind_units[.x])
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Skenario = "BAU")

# ---- 3. Ringkasan Skenario ----
sum_sc <- purrr::map2_dfr(
  ind_cols, seq_along(ind_cols),
  ~ summary_row(result_scenario, .x, ind_titles[.x], ind_units[.x])
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Skenario = "Skenario")

# ---- 4. Gabungkan BAU + Skenario, urutkan per Indikator ----
sum_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(sum_bau, sum_sc) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Indikator = factor(Indikator, levels = ind_titles),
    Skenario  = factor(Skenario, levels = c("BAU", "Skenario"))
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Indikator, Skenario) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Indikator = as.character(Indikator),
    Skenario  = as.character(Skenario)
  ) |>
  # Urutan kolom: Indikator dulu, Skenario kedua
  dplyr::select(
    Indikator, Skenario, Satuan,
    `Nilai Awal`, `Nilai Akhir`, `Pertumbuhan (%)`
  )

# ---- 5. Tambahkan kolom bar Perbandingan ----
# `Pertumbuhan (%)` masih dipakai untuk hitung bar_width & label,
# lalu dihapus di akhir step ini.
sum_all <- sum_all %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Indikator) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    max_growth = max(`Pertumbuhan (%)`, na.rm = TRUE),
    bar_width  = pmax(0, pmin(100, `Pertumbuhan (%)` / max_growth * 100)),
    bar_color  = ifelse(Skenario == "BAU", "#4A90E2", "#F18F01"),
    Pertumbuhan = sprintf(
      '<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
         <div style="flex:1; background:#eee; height:14px; border-radius:3px; overflow:hidden;">
           <div style="width:%.1f%%; background:%s; height:100%%;"></div>
         </div>
         <span style="font-size:11px; color:#666; min-width:45px; text-align:right;">%.1f%%</span>
       </div>',
      bar_width, bar_color, `Pertumbuhan (%)`
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  # Hapus kolom Pertumbuhan (%) beserta kolom bantu
  dplyr::select(-max_growth, -bar_width, -bar_color, -`Pertumbuhan (%)`)

# ---- 6. Render tabel ----
DT::datatable(
  sum_all,
  rownames   = FALSE,
  caption    = paste0(
    "Ringkasan Eksekutif: Nilai Awal (", params$initial_year,
    ") vs Nilai Akhir (", params$end_year, ")"
  ),
  escape     = FALSE,          
  extensions = "Buttons",
  options    = list(
    pageLength = 15,
    dom        = "Bfrtip",
    buttons    = c("copy", "excel", "csv"),
    scrollX    = TRUE,
    columnDefs = list(
      list(
        targets = which(names(sum_all) == "Perbandingan") - 1,
        width   = "180px"
      )
    )
  )
) |>
  DT::formatRound(c("Nilai Awal", "Nilai Akhir"), digits = 2, mark = ",")
```

## PDRB per Sektor

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
sector_summary <- result_scenario |>
  dplyr::group_by(SECTOR) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    GDP_Awal  = GDP[YEAR == min(YEAR)],
    GDP_Akhir = GDP[YEAR == max(YEAR)],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Pertumbuhan_Pct = (GDP_Akhir / GDP_Awal - 1) * 100
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(GDP_Akhir)) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    `Sektor`                        = SECTOR,
    `PDRB Awal (Rp Juta)`           = GDP_Awal,
    `PDRB Akhir (Rp Juta)`          = GDP_Akhir,
    `Pertumbuhan (%)`               = Pertumbuhan_Pct
  )

top20 <- head(sector_summary, 20)

DT::datatable(
  top20,
  rownames   = FALSE,
  caption    = paste0(
    "Top 20 Sektor berdasarkan PDRB Akhir (Skenario) — ",
    params$initial_year, " s.d. ", params$end_year
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
  DT::formatRound("Pertumbuhan (%)", digits = 2)
```

```{r, linkage-a3, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
has_a3 <- "A3" %in% active_assumptions
lk     <- params$linkage_compare

data_ok <- is.data.frame(lk) && nrow(lk) > 0 &&
  all(c("SECTOR", "ITBL_BEFORE", "ITBL_AFTER", "ITFL_BEFORE", "ITFL_AFTER") %in% names(lk))

if (has_a3 && data_ok) {

  lk$DELTA_ITBL <- lk$ITBL_AFTER - lk$ITBL_BEFORE
  lk$DELTA_ITFL <- lk$ITFL_AFTER - lk$ITFL_BEFORE

  # Grafik interaktif Top-N sektor dengan perubahan terbesar untuk satu indeks
  build_linkage_plot <- function(lk, type, n_top = 15) {
    d <- data.frame(
      Sektor  = lk$SECTOR,
      Sebelum = lk[[paste0(type, "_BEFORE")]],
      Sesudah = lk[[paste0(type, "_AFTER")]],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    d$Delta <- d$Sesudah - d$Sebelum
    d <- d[order(-abs(d$Delta)), ][1:min(n_top, nrow(d)), ]

    d_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(
      d, cols = c("Sebelum", "Sesudah"),
      names_to = "Status", values_to = "Indeks"
    )
    d_long$Status <- factor(d_long$Status, levels = c("Sebelum", "Sesudah"))

    p <- ggplot(d_long, aes(x = reorder(Sektor, Indeks), y = Indeks, fill = Status)) +
      geom_col(position = "dodge") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(Sebelum = "#bdc3c7", Sesudah = "#27ae60")) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
      labs(
        title = paste0("Perubahan ", type, " (Top ", nrow(d), ")"),
        x = NULL, y = paste("Indeks", type), fill = NULL
      )

    plotly::ggplotly(p)
  }

  cat("\n\n# Analisis Linkage (Asumsi 3: Hilirisasi) {.tabset .tabset-pills}\n\n")

  # --- Tab 1: ITBL ---
  cat("\n\n## Grafik ITBL (Backward)\n\n")
  cat(as.character(htmltools::tagList(build_linkage_plot(lk, "ITBL"))))
  cat("\n\n")

  # --- Tab 2: ITFL ---
  cat("\n\n## Grafik ITFL (Forward)\n\n")
  cat(as.character(htmltools::tagList(build_linkage_plot(lk, "ITFL"))))
  cat("\n\n")

  # --- Tab 3: Tabel (semua sektor, ITBL dan ITFL) ---
  cat("\n\n## Tabel Perubahan Linkage\n\n")

  dt_all <- data.frame(
    Sektor         = lk$SECTOR,
    `ITBL Sebelum` = lk$ITBL_BEFORE,
    `ITBL Sesudah` = lk$ITBL_AFTER,
    `ΔITBL`        = lk$DELTA_ITBL,
    `ITFL Sebelum` = lk$ITFL_BEFORE,
    `ITFL Sesudah` = lk$ITFL_AFTER,
    `ΔITFL`        = lk$DELTA_ITFL,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  dt_all <- dt_all[order(-pmax(abs(dt_all$`ΔITBL`), abs(dt_all$`ΔITFL`))), ]

  dt_widget <- DT::datatable(
    dt_all,
    rownames   = FALSE,
    caption    = "Perubahan ITBL dan ITFL per Sektor (diurutkan menurut perubahan terbesar)",
    extensions = "Buttons",
    options    = list(
      pageLength = 15,
      dom        = "Bfrtip",
      buttons    = c("copy", "excel", "csv"),
      scrollX    = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
    DT::formatRound(
      c("ITBL Sebelum", "ITBL Sesudah", "ΔITBL",
        "ITFL Sebelum", "ITFL Sesudah", "ΔITFL"),
      digits = 4, mark = ","
    )

  cat(as.character(htmltools::tagList(dt_widget)))
  cat("\n\n")

  # --- Catatan interpretasi ---
  cat("Indeks Total Backward Linkage (ITBL) menunjukkan seberapa besar suatu sektor menyerap input dari sektor lain, sedangkan Indeks Total Forward Linkage (ITFL) menunjukkan seberapa besar output suatu sektor dipakai sebagai input oleh sektor lain. Indeks di atas 1 berarti keterkaitan sektor tersebut di atas rata-rata seluruh sektor. Perubahan positif (ΔITBL atau ΔITFL > 0) berarti keterkaitan sektor menguat setelah restrukturisasi tabel I-O, perubahan negatif berarti melemah.\n\n")
}
```

<font size="1"> LUMENS adalah perangkat lunak bebas dan disediakan TANPA JAMINAN APAPUN. Pengguna bertanggung jawab atas hasil yang dihasilkan. Hasil bergantung pada kualitas data input ("garbage in, garbage out") dan dapat bervariasi atau sensitif terhadap parameter yang digunakan. </font>
